Saved.note: Saved state: GitHub-default branch select, run command Input, ScriptBlock with a real setup.sh, success badge, both footer buttons disabled.

UnsavedChanges.note: Dirty state with an explicit branch selected, an edited run command and an info badge with live Revert/Save.

Saving.note: saving=true puts the Save button in its loading state and holds Revert, with the neutral Saving badge.

BranchLoadFailed.note: branchError swaps the helper text, branches is empty, and the destructive error paragraph renders above the footer. Placeholders show through the empty run command and script fields.
